news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.026 loss per share (vs ₹0.032 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.026 loss per share (improved from ₹0.032 loss in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹1.77m (loss narrowed 19% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 4% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 2% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.005 loss per share (vs ₹0.007 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.005 loss per share (down from ₹0.007 profit in 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹356.9k (down 180% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 44% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 12% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
